type: research and generated concepts, no implementation/deployment
findings: Adobe/Capture One expose size, opacity and positioning; Adobe also shadow. No universal numerical standard found. Shutterstock protects stock previews with contributor attribution; not a suitable visual density target for SNS. All 5 are Crefans proposals, not provider screenshots. Opacity/size values are proposed targets, not pixel-verified generated output.

variants.title: 미니멀
variants.style: Small white plain text, opacity 40%, font target 2% of image short edge, no shadow no background. Very understated.
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished visual review sheet for Crefans watermark option 01, title "01 미니멀". Portrait format, high resolution, white background, clean Korean sans serif typography, understated blue accents. This is a visual concept, not an existing provider screenshot. Two large photographic panels stacked vertically with generous space: upper panel labeled "사진" shows realistic close-up of a strawberry waffle and iced coffee on a bright sunlit cafe table; lower panel labeled "영상 썸네일" shows realistic cinematic dusk Seoul cafe street with warm lamps and dark pavement, a tiny play icon at upper left. Photographs should occupy most of sheet, use 16:9 frames. On BOTH photos put exact watermark text "https://crefans.com/crefans" at BOTTOM RIGHT, inset 3% of image short edge, small and subtle but readable. Small white plain text, opacity 40%, font target 2% of image short edge, no shadow no background. Very understated. The bottom right of bright photo is pale wood, bottom right of video is dark street to demonstrate contrast. Repeat neither watermark nor logo elsewhere in photos. Under each panel include a small magnified rectangular crop of its watermark region labeled "확대" so subtle rendering can be judged; crops must depict same watermark appearance. Only title, 사진, 영상 썸네일, 확대, and watermark URL text; no marketing copy, no invented numerical claims. Tasteful professional design, no oversized watermark, no giant 3D logos.
